limitations: Synthetic practice data supplied for this hackathon, not real transactional or bank data; treat scores as a demonstration of the method, not a live risk assessment.
Each row is an independent business-month snapshot; the same business cannot be tracked across months, so the model cannot learn a business's own trend.
Evaluated on the last few months only, held out chronologically; a longer or more varied period could score differently.
Scores are a ranking signal, not a calibrated probability of cash-flow stress.
